title: Linked-issue Copilot notification dedupe: marker in body and check must match
answers: duplicate comments on linked issue when copilot-agent workflow reruns
Copilot posts 'opened #N for this issue' twice on the same issue
how to avoid repeated notification comments on linked issues for a PR
body:
Symptom: Re-running the copilot-agent workflow on a PR posts the same "Copilot opened #N for this issue." comment again on each linked issue.
Root cause: .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml (run step that notifies closingIssuesReferences) posted the comment unconditionally, with no per-PR key to detect an earlier post.
Fix pattern: Build a PR-specific HTML marker (<!-- copilot-agent-pr:${PR_NUMBER} -->) and append it to the comment body. Fetch comments(last: 100) in the same GraphQL query, then drop issues where any fetched comment contains the marker (jq select(any(...; contains($marker)) | not)).
Constraints: The marker must derive from the same PR_NUMBER used for the check, and the body must still include it. The check only sees the last 100 comments per issue, so a marker older than that window can still be re-posted. Different PRs get different markers, so they still notify the same issue independently.
applies: Only the copilot-agent workflow's linked-issue notification step; any change to the comment text or marker format must keep both sides in sync.
says: The bot posts duplicate notification comments on linked issues whenever a workflow is rerun.
Rerunning the pull request checks causes repeated comments on the linked issue thread.
Prevent identical pull request opening notices from spamming the linked issue activity feed.
Linked issue shows the same pull request opened message twice after a rerun.
search: In `.github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml`, linked-issue notification deduplication appends an HTML marker `<!-- copilot-agent-pr:${PR_NUMBER} -->` to the comment body and filters out issues where `comments(last: 100)` contains that marker. The check and comment body must use the same `PR_NUMBER` marker format to stay in sync. Because only the last 100 comments are checked, older markers can still allow re-posting, while distinct pull requests use distinct markers to notify independently.
